summary: Verified 2026 signals materially strengthen the case for an edge-first, simulation-heavy AETHERHOME stack with human fallback: Google DeepMind has moved Gemini Robotics 2 and an on-device VLA into whole-body and local robot control; NVIDIA now offers an open GR00T humanoid reference stack around Jetson Thor; Figure reports >350 Figure 03 units produced and a ramp from one robot/day to one/hour; U.S. AV policy is becoming more deployment-friendly. These are industry signals, not evidence that AETHERHOME itself is technically ready, funded, partnered or deployed.

signals.headline: VERIFIED: Gemini Robotics 2 adds whole-body VLA control and Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 targets local manipulation; NVIDIA's GR00T reference design combines open humanoid software with Jetson Thor.
signals.impact: INFERENCE: Build ATLAS around swappable local embodied policies, explicit safety constraints and teleoperation fallback.

signals.headline: VERIFIED: Figure reports 16M+ human-task videos in its Index pipeline; leading VLA programs combine human video, robot demonstrations, simulation and synthetic data.
signals.impact: INFERENCE: Cabin-specific task data, evaluation and recovery policies are a more credible early moat than training a frontier model from scratch.

signals.headline: VERIFIED: Jetson Thor offers up to 2,070 FP4 TFLOPS, 128 GB memory and 40-130 W operation; NVIDIA Marketplace lists the developer kit at $5,499.
signals.impact: INFERENCE: Local perception/reasoning is increasingly practical for prototypes, but this is not a production BOM quote.

signals.headline: VERIFIED: Lambda lists H100 PCIe at $3.29/GPU-hour, H100 SXM at $4.29 and B200 at $6.99; AWS H100 Capacity Blocks are about $4.72/GPU-hour in Mumbai and $5.191 in several U.S. regions.
signals.impact: INFERENCE: Prefer bursty cloud training/simulation and edge inference at the current stage.

signals.headline: VERIFIED: NVIDIA reports broader DRIVE Hyperion L4-ready OEM adoption; NHTSA is developing AV performance standards and granted Zoox a temporary commercial exemption for up to 2,500 vehicles annually for two years.
signals.impact: INFERENCE: Integrate a certified vehicle/autonomy platform rather than build road autonomy from first principles.

signals.headline: VERIFIED: Figure says BotQ has delivered >350 Figure 03 robots and increased production from one/day to one/hour; Agility opened a 60,000-sq-ft Physical AI facility alongside RoboFab.
signals.impact: INFERENCE: Fleet learning and manufacturability now matter earlier, but vendor-reported throughput does not prove reliability or unit economics.

signals.headline: VERIFIED: ISO 10218-1:2025 and 10218-2:2025 are current industrial robot safety standards; the EU AI Act became broadly applicable on 2 August 2026; U.S. AV exemptions are being streamlined.
signals.impact: INFERENCE: Safety logging, fail-safe behavior, human override and traceability should be designed into the software architecture from P1.

signals.headline: VERIFIED SIGNAL: public Bay Area robotics postings commonly show roughly $150K-$250K base for lead platform roles and $180K-$250K for senior embedded humanoid roles, often plus equity.
signals.impact: INFERENCE: Keep the U.S. senior integration core small and leverage global engineering capacity early.

signals.headline: VERIFIED: Apptronik reports >$935M Series A; Figure previously announced >$1B Series C at $39B post-money; Xpeng Robotics announced >$900M in its first external round at >$6.3B valuation.
signals.impact: INFERENCE: Frontier humanoid hardware remains extremely capital intensive; AETHERHOME should finance by capability milestones.

cost_watch.gpu: Current official reference points: Lambda 1x H100 PCIe $3.29/hr, H100 SXM $4.29/hr, B200 $6.99/hr; AWS H100 Capacity Blocks about $4.72/hr in Mumbai and $5.191/hr in several U.S. regions. Public prices are transient and not contracted quotes.
cost_watch.talent: Public U.S. postings continue to signal roughly $150K-$250K+ base for senior/lead robotics platform and embedded roles, often plus equity.
cost_watch.prototype: No verified evidence this week justifies changing the journey cost bands. Jetson Thor's public developer-kit price is useful for prototyping but is not a production BOM.

roadmap_updates: No phase or cost-band change. Strengthen P1/P3 around edge-first VLA evaluation, teleoperation fallback, task-data capture and safety logging; keep P4 focused on certified vehicle/autonomy integration.
